verdict: GBP listings went dark this week; paid channels remain offline.
narrative: Across all three locations — Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision — Google Business Profile was the only active source of engagement this period, generating a combined 330 actions (direction requests, calls, and website clicks). That signal has now gone to zero across all three listings for the past 8–11 days, a simultaneous drop that points to a shared listing issue being investigated and resolved now. Paid advertising on Meta and Google has been inactive throughout the full 28-day window, meaning no leads were generated through paid channels this period. Several foundational workstreams — contact list builds and web/SEO groundwork — are overdue and are being escalated this week to unblock the outreach and search recovery work scheduled for September and October.
